title: E-SPN-0198: The chiral slab's wall-pair leak as a two-path evanescent sum: each domain's decay kappa and wave number...
purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0198 in the spin arena: The chiral slab's wall-pair leak as a two-path evanescent sum: each domain's decay kappa and wave number q at quasienergy pi from its bulk symbol alone (complex band structure), frozen, then tested on 81 asymmetric slabs (Wilson width and plain width 4 to 12 each), fit on 45 and predicted on 36.
